summary.text: Congregated Human Talent is a Chai clan human path killer move. Fang Yuan's envoys name it when they open purchase talks at Human Smoke Mountain.

claims.text: At Southern Border’s Human Smoke Mountain, almost all Chai clan Gu Immortals assemble under first supreme elder Chai Gan to receive Bing Yuan, Golden Fur Immortal Monarch, and Shi Zong. Bing Yuan says they came on Fang Yuan’s order to discuss a trade, then asks to buy the killer move congregated human talent together with Human Smoke Mountain and many mortals the clan has raised. Chai clan immortals treat the demand as digging up their foundation; when Chai Gan asks what Fang Yuan wants the mortals for, Shi Zong sneers that they will kill them all, and Golden Fur Immortal Monarch adds that their abundant human qi will finish Fang Yuan’s Human Sea.

Thousands of years earlier, rank eight lone cultivator Chai Fu, near the end of his lifespan on Human Smoke Mountain, gains inspiration in closed cultivation and settles on a human path killer move he names congregated human talent. He had been conceptualizing a lifespan extension method; the final result is this move instead. Congregated human talent concentrates the aptitude of many people into a small group. Using the move as foundation with the favorable location of Human Smoke Mountain, he establishes the super force Chai clan, gathers and nurtures outsiders, and transfers their aptitude to Chai clansmen so geniuses keep emerging while outsiders stay mediocre. In the present, Fang Yuan directly asks for congregated human talent, Human Smoke Mountain, and the outsider mortals Chai clan is nurturing, excavating the core foundation that established the clan’s status.
